item.title: Utah Measles Outbreak: Adapting to Common Vaccine-Preventable Diseases
item.description:
A measles outbreak in Utah is forcing residents and medical staff to adapt to the reality of vaccine-preventable diseases becoming common again. The situation highlights the challenges of managing public health crises in the modern era.

item.title: Scientist Charged With Smuggling Mpox Virus into U.S.
item.description:
A virologist was stopped at the Detroit airport after working in Congo during an mpox epidemic. His lawyer stated that the materials were intended for research purposes.
